login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: One Hub. Every Booking.
login.organizationHint: The slug your hotel signed up with
login.passwordReset: Your password has been changed. Sign in with the new one.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.intro: We will email you a link to choose a new one.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, a link to choose a new password is on its way.
forgotPassword.sentHint: The link works once and expires in an hour. Look in your spam folder if it has not arrived in a few minutes.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.mismatch: The two passwords do not match
resetPassword.noTokenBody: Open the link from the email exactly as it was sent, or ask for a new one.

inventory.title: Inventory
inventory.subtitle: Rooms available to sell, by night
inventory.noRoomTypesHint: Availability is held per room type, so there is nothing to load until you have at least one.
inventory.noRateWarning: Open for sale with no price — these nights cannot be booked.

reservations.title: Reservations
reservations.subtitle: Every booking for this property
reservations.search: Search by reference, guest, email or phone
reservations.notFound: That reservation does not exist, or belongs to another property.
reservations.cancelExplain: Nights that have not been consumed are released back to inventory. Nights already stayed are kept.
reservations.noActions: No action is available for a booking in this state.
reservations.readOnly: You do not have permission to change this booking.
reservations.staleData: Someone else changed this booking. Reload to see the current state.
reservations.newSubtitle: Take a booking at the desk, by phone or by email
reservations.availabilityHint: Availability is shown for information. Nothing is held until you save, and the API decides at that moment.
reservations.noRoomTypes: This property has no room types yet.
reservations.noRoomTypesHint: A booking needs something to sell. Create a room type and a rate plan first.
reservations.noRatePlan: No rate plan for this room type
reservations.requiredDates: Choose a check-in and a check-out date.
reservations.requiredBooker: Enter the name of whoever is booking.
reservations.requiredRatePlan: Choose a rate plan for every room.
reservations.assignmentCleared: The room assignment was cleared. Assign a room again before check-in.
reservations.modifyLocked: A {status} booking can no longer be changed.
reservations.modifyHint: Moving dates or changing the room type releases the old nights and takes the new ones. Prices are re-quoted at today's rates for the nights that change.
reservations.extendDone: Extended. The added nights come to {amount}.
reservations.departureHint: Only the departure date moves. Nights already booked keep the price they were quoted; added nights are priced at today's rate.
reservations.departureUnchanged: That is already the departure date.
reservations.departureWillExtend: This adds nights to the end of the stay and holds inventory for them.
reservations.departureWillShorten: This releases the dropped nights back for sale and takes them off the bill. No fee is added — post one to the guest account if your terms call for it.
reservations.shortenDone: Departure moved earlier. {nights} night(s) released and {amount} taken off the bill. Post an early-departure fee to the guest account if your terms call for one.
reservations.earlyExplain: The booking and the bill do not change — the guest stays charged in full. The only choice is whether the nights they are not using go back on sale.
reservations.earlyWarning: Putting them back offers the room on every channel within seconds. Take the key back first.
reservations.earlyRelease: Check out and put the room back on sale
reservations.earlyKeep: Check out and hold the room

folio.title: Guest account
folio.voidReason: Why is this line being reversed? The reason is kept with it.
folio.amountRequired: Enter an amount greater than zero.

errors.allotmentBelowBooked: Allotment cannot be lower than the rooms already sold
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that

account.title: Change password
account.subtitle: Changing your password signs out every other device.
account.mismatch: The two new passwords do not match.
account.success: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.

roomTypes.title: Room types
roomTypes.subtitle: What you sell. Each one holds its own availability and rates.
roomTypes.empty: No room types yet. Add the first one to start loading availability.
roomTypes.emptyHint: A room type is a category you sell — Deluxe Double, Standard Twin — not an individual room.
roomTypes.codeHint: Used in OTA mappings. Cannot be changed later.
roomTypes.name: Name
roomTypes.standardHint: Guests included in the base rate.
roomTypes.codeTaken: That code is already used at this property.
roomTypes.failed: Could not save the room type.
roomTypes.noDelete: Room types are never deleted — inventory, rates and past bookings point at them. Stop selling instead.

ratePlans.title: Rate plans
ratePlans.subtitle: How each room type is priced. A room type with no priced nights cannot be sold.
ratePlans.emptyHint: Every room type needs at least one plan with prices before it can be booked.
ratePlans.needRoomType: Add a room type first — a rate plan is always attached to one.
ratePlans.codeHint: Used in OTA rate mappings. Cannot be changed later.
ratePlans.name: Name
ratePlans.codeTaken: That code is already used at this property.
ratePlans.failed: Could not save the rate plan.
ratePlans.noDelete: Rate plans are never deleted — priced nights and past bookings point at them. Stop selling instead.
ratePlans.weekdaysHint: Leave all off to apply to every night in the range.
ratePlans.occupancyHint: {currency}, per night. A booking is priced by the number of guests, so every occupancy you sell needs a price.
ratePlans.priceRequired: Enter a price for at least one occupancy.
ratePlans.rangeInvalid: The end date must be after the start date.
ratePlans.clearExplain: This deletes the prices themselves — it does not set them to zero. A night with no price cannot be booked at all.
ratePlans.clearZeroWarning: Setting a price to 0 would leave the room sellable for nothing. Removing it takes the night off sale instead.
ratePlans.clearOccupanciesHint: Leave all off to remove every occupancy on those nights.
ratePlans.clearNothing: No prices existed in that range — nothing was removed.
ratePlans.clearUnsellable: {count} nights can no longer be sold: they still have rooms allotted but no price from any active plan.
ratePlans.clearUnsellableNone: No night lost its last price.
ratePlans.derivedHint: It takes its parent price and applies an offset, so one edit reprices every night.
ratePlans.offsetRequired: Enter an offset other than zero.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: Who can sign in, and what they are allowed to do.
team.emailTaken: That email already has an account in this organization.
team.noDelete: Accounts are never deleted — audit entries and reservations point at who did what. Disable instead.
team.passwordIntro: Give these to {name}. This password is shown once and cannot be retrieved again.
team.passwordAdvise: Ask them to change it at Account as soon as they sign in.
team.cannotSelf: You cannot change your own role or status.
team.roleHint: You can only assign roles at or below your own.
team.noAccess: You do not have access to the team list
team.noAccessHint: Managing colleagues is an organization-wide permission. Someone with an organization-wide Admin or Owner role can grant it.
team.resetIntro: Give this to {name}. It is shown once and cannot be retrieved again — every session they had has been signed out.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.subtitle: Physical rooms, for assignment and housekeeping. These never change what you can sell.
rooms.neverAffects: Room count does not set availability — allotment does. Adding rooms here will not change what an OTA sees.
rooms.emptyHint: Rooms are only needed to put guests somewhere and track housekeeping. You can sell without them.
rooms.needRoomType: Add a room type first — every room belongs to one.
rooms.numberTaken: That room number is already used at this property.
rooms.noDelete: Rooms are never deleted — past assignments point at them. Take out of service instead.

stayView.title: Stay view
stayView.subtitle: Who is in which room. Separate from inventory on purpose — this does not affect what you sell.
stayView.emptyHint: The stay view shows physical rooms. Add some to start assigning guests.
stayView.unassignedEmpty: Every booking in this window has a room.

reports.title: Performance
reports.subtitle: Rooms sold, revenue and the rates behind them.
reports.adrHint: Average daily rate — revenue divided by rooms sold.
reports.occupancyHint: Rooms sold over physical rooms, the industry definition.
reports.revparHint: Revenue per available room — occupancy multiplied by ADR.
reports.sellThroughHint: How much of what you offered for sale you actually sold.
reports.noRooms: Occupancy and RevPAR need physical rooms
reports.noRoomsHint: They are measured against the rooms a hotel has, which is what an owner compares against. Sell-through below is measured against your allotment and is always available.
reports.pickupSubtitle: Business taken for the nights ahead, since a week ago.

pickup.pickupRoomsHint: Net change since {date}, across the nights below.
pickup.pickupRevenueHint: What those rooms are worth at the prices they were sold.
pickup.onTheBooksHint: Room-nights sold for the window, right now.
pickup.baselineMoved: No snapshot exists for {requested}, so this compares against {used} instead — a longer span than it says.
pickup.noBaseline: Pickup needs a few days of history first
pickup.noBaselineHint: On-the-books figures are recorded once a day, and pickup is the difference between two of them. Nothing can be compared until the second one exists — check back tomorrow.

guests.title: Guests
guests.subtitle: Everyone who has booked, and how often they come back.
guests.search: Search by name, email or phone
guests.emptyHint: A profile is created from the booker the first time someone books.
guests.name: Name
guests.duplicate: Might be the same person as {count} other profile
guests.duplicates: Might be the same person as {count} other profiles
guests.duplicateHint: Two people can share an address, so these are flagged for review rather than merged automatically.
guests.noCandidates: Nothing matches this profile any more.
guests.noContact: No email or phone on file
guests.mergeInto: Fold another profile into {name}. This profile is the one that is kept.
guests.mergeConfirm: Move every stay from {from} to {into}? This cannot be undone.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: What this hotel told guests and staff, and what it could not
notifications.emptyHint: Messages are written when a booking is confirmed, cancelled, or arrives from a channel.

channels.title: Channels
channels.subtitle: OTA connections for this property
channels.emptyHint: A channel connects this hotel to an OTA. Create one, map every room type, then activate it.
channels.name: Name
channels.credentialsHint: Write-only. Values are encrypted and never shown again — leave blank to keep what is stored.
channels.activateBlocked: Map every room type before activating.
channels.mappingsHint: The OTA's own id for each room type. Availability for an unmapped room type is never pushed, so the OTA keeps selling stale numbers.
channels.markupHint: What this plan's price is multiplied by before it goes to this channel. 1.00 sends the direct price unchanged; 1.80 sends it 80% higher, which is what covers OTA discounting and commission. Direct bookings are never affected.
channels.noInbound: No bookings received from this channel
channels.syncDisabledWarning: Channel sync is switched off in this deployment, so an active channel will not push anything until CHANNEL_SYNC_ENABLED is turned on.
channels.testNotOk: The channel did not accept us: {detail}
channels.testFailed: The test could not be run
channels.syncNeedsActive: Only an active channel can be pushed to.
channels.syncHint: Sends the whole horizon again. Useful after fixing a mapping, or when you do not trust what the OTA is showing.
channels.syncPartial: {failed} of {rooms} room type(s) failed. The rest were pushed.
channels.syncFailed: The push could not be started
